title: The Last Crossing
summary: Run the rain-slick roofs of two elevated trains above Taipei. Jump the vents and swing across three gaps to reach the evacuation gate in this short 3D proof of concept.
summaryZhTW: 在臺北高架軌道上，沿著雨水打濕的車頂奔跑。躍過通風設備，用纜索在兩列車之間擺盪三次，抵達撤離門。《末班線》是一款短篇 3D 動作概念驗證作品。
coverAlt: A runner in a yellow raincoat stands on a wet train roof reflecting an overhead gantry. A second train runs alongside it above Taipei.
controls: Move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with Space, and press E to tether. Drag to look around.
limitations: A short proof of concept. Requires a WebGL-enabled browser.

approval.note: Creator approved publishing the tested proof of concept to Possibility Games.
